alt.en: The Davis Centre, a University of Waterloo building with a curved wall of glass panels, large gray pipes arching over its roof and red posts at its entrance, seen across a paved plaza with concrete planters under a blue sky.
alt.zh: 滑铁卢大学的 Davis Centre 大楼：弧形的玻璃幕墙上方弯着几根粗大的灰色管道，入口处立着红色立柱；楼前是铺砖广场和混凝土花坛，天空湛蓝。

caption.en: The Davis Centre, a University of Waterloo building in Waterloo, Ontario, in June 2025. All three authors list the university as an affiliation. The photo does not show the researchers or their work.
caption.zh: 滑铁卢大学的 Davis Centre 大楼，位于安大略省滑铁卢，摄于 2025 年 6 月。论文的三位作者都把该校列为所属机构。照片中没有研究人员，也没有他们的研究工作。
